locations.note: Detective Lazarus Bundy investigates Kathrin Mulzberg's disappearance in Miami before following the case to Italy.
The investigation reaches a recognizable San Leo, including Piazza Dante, the civic tower and the fortress associated with Cagliostro.
Part 2 opens on Piazza Dante Alighieri in San Leo.
The fortress where Cagliostro died, climbed for the trail of the hand.
A visit to the church of St. Francis at La Verna.
Alice calls on Professor Visconi's house in Rome.
The finale moves to a pub, a cemetery and a crypt in England.
